## Review guidance

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is scoped to the linked problem and unrelated edits are excluded.
- [ ] New or changed behavior is covered by tests, or the reason it is not is documented.
- [ ] External inputs and malformed/truncated data are handled at the boundary where applicable.
- [ ] Public API, architecture, README, CLI help, and examples are updated where affected.
- [ ] Affected generated artifacts were regenerated by their owning tool rather than hand-edited.
- [ ] Affected platform and feature-gated behavior remains portable or is gated at the narrowest boundary.
